content.summary: Options ranked by time-to-learning for sleep/wake timeout/UnknownError failures

data.problem: Intermittent provider failures (timeout and UnknownError) appear during/after Mac sleep-wake while requests are in-flight; timeout and cancellation now rely on merged abort signals in provider fetch wrapper.
constraints: Need evidence tied to provider timeout/signal path in provider.ts.
Must preserve session cancellation semantics and avoid breaking retries.
Issue is intermittent and likely timing-sensitive (sleep/wake window).

options.name: Config A/B isolation (no code)
options.approach: Run controlled sessions with provider timeout=false, then explicit timeout (e.g. 300000), force sleep/wake mid-request, compare error classes and persistence behavior.
options.what_we_learn: Whether timeout signal path itself is the dominant trigger vs generic post-sleep transport instability.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low; may only narrow scope without root cause.

options.name: High-signal diagnostics at fetch/error boundary
options.approach: Temporarily instrument provider fetch wrapper and MessageV2.fromError to log timeout value, signal.aborted/reason name, thrown error constructor/name, and APICallError detection outcome.
options.what_we_learn: Exact error-shape mismatch causing UnknownError and whether AbortSignal.timeout emits AbortError vs TimeoutError in real failures.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low-medium; could still miss race if reproduction is rare.

options.name: Targeted normalization fix experiment
options.approach: Prototype handling for TimeoutError/ETIMEDOUT/abort-like variants in MessageV2.fromError and retry classification, then rerun sleep/wake scenario.
options.what_we_learn: Whether user-visible UnknownError is mostly classification debt rather than transport behavior.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium; may improve UX while underlying transport issue remains.

options.name: Provider fetch wrapper semantics hardening
options.approach: Prototype non-mutating signal composition and optional clearable timeout helper to avoid stale signal propagation and timer side effects.
options.what_we_learn: Whether mutable init/signal composition contributes to intermittent failures after long-lived/sleep-disrupted requests.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium; broader surface area and harder to isolate causality.

data.recommendation: Option 1 first, then Option 2 immediately if failures reproduce. This gives fastest causal separation (timeout path vs generic sleep/wake transport breakage) with minimal blast radius.
